Metadata.description: Element is a secure document management platform for organizations and their clients.

Footer.tagline: Secure document management for organizations and their clients.
Footer.placeholderNotice: Contact details are placeholders pending confirmation.

Home.title: Your documents, managed with security and order
Home.body: Element provides a private, controlled space to receive, store and consult your documents, with access limited to authorized people.

security.title: Controlled access
security.body: Each person sees only the documents that belong to them. Every action is recorded.

privacy.title: Private storage
privacy.body: Files are stored in private storage and downloaded only through temporary links.

support.title: Institutional support
support.body: Accounts are created and managed by our team; there is no open registration.

Panel.comingSoonBody: This section will be available in an upcoming phase of the project.

Auth.recaptchaNotice: This site is protected by reCAPTCHA. Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access your account.
signIn.closedRegistration: Accounts are created by the administrator. If you need access, please contact us.
signIn.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
signIn.passwordUpdated: Your password has been updated. Please sign in.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Enter your email address and, if an account exists, we will send you instructions to set a new password.
reset.success: If the address belongs to an active account, you will receive an email with instructions within a few minutes. The link is valid for 24 hours and can be used only once.

update.title: Set a new password
update.subtitle: Choose a password you do not use on other sites.
update.requirements: At least 12 characters, including uppercase and lowercase letters and numbers.

confirm.title: Confirm access
confirm.body: To continue, confirm that you want to use this link. For your security, it can be used only once.
confirm.invalid: This link is invalid, has expired or has already been used. Request a new one or contact the administrator.

mfa.enrollBody: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example, Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.requiredForAdmins: Two-step verification is mandatory for administrator accounts.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to set up the authenticator app
mfa.manualKey: If you cannot scan the code, enter this key manually:
mfa.verifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

Validation.passwordMin: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
Validation.passwordMax: The password must be at most 128 characters long.
Validation.passwordComplexity: The password must include uppercase and lowercase letters and numbers.
Validation.invalid: The value entered is not valid.

Errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a few minutes.
Errors.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is incorrect, or the account is not available.
Errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
Errors.recaptchaFailed: We could not verify your request. Please reload the page and try again.
Errors.linkInvalid: This link is invalid, has expired or has already been used.
Errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
Errors.weakPassword: This password is not secure enough. Choose a different one.
Errors.mfaInvalid: The code is incorrect or has expired.
Errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
Errors.selfAction: You cannot perform this action on your own account.
Errors.lastAdmin: This is the last active administrator account; it cannot be deactivated.
Errors.emailExists: An account with this email address already exists.
Errors.notPending: This account has already been activated; the invitation cannot be resent.
Errors.notFound: The requested item no longer exists. Reload the page.
Errors.duplicateName: A category with this name already exists.
Errors.deliveryFailed: The action was completed, but the email could not be sent. Try again later.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.

ErrorPage.title: An error occurred
ErrorPage.body: We could not complete your request. Please try again; if the problem persists, contact us.

Email.automatedNotice: This is an automated message from Element. Please do not reply to this email.
Email.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy and paste this address into your browser:

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.preview: Instructions to set a new password for your Element account.
passwordReset.heading: Password reset
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your Element account. To set a new password, use the button below.
passwordReset.expiry: This link is valid for 24 hours and can be used only once.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not request this change, you can ignore this message; your password will remain the same.

invitation.subject: Your Element account invitation
invitation.preview: You have been invited to access Element.
invitation.heading: Welcome to Element
invitation.body: An administrator has created an account for you on Element. To activate it, set your password using the button below.
invitation.expiry: This link is valid for 24 hours and can be used only once.
invitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this message.

fileAssigned.subject: A new document is available
fileAssigned.preview: A new document has been added to your Element account.
fileAssigned.heading: New document available
fileAssigned.body: An administrator has added the document “{fileName}” to your Element account. You can view and download it from your panel.

passwordForced.subject: Your password was reset
passwordForced.preview: An administrator reset the password of your Element account.
passwordForced.heading: Password reset by an administrator
passwordForced.body: For security reasons, an administrator reset the password of your Element account and closed your active sessions. To access your account again, set a new password with the button below.
passwordForced.expiry: This link is valid for 24 hours and can be used only once.
passwordForced.ignore: If you have questions about this change, contact the administrator.

Files.description: Documents in your account. Downloads use temporary links valid for 60 seconds.

empty.title: You have no files yet
empty.body: Files you upload, or that the administrator assigns to you, will appear here.

noResults.title: No files match the filters
noResults.body: Adjust or clear the filters to see more results.

Upload.description: Files are verified before they are stored. Only the listed formats are accepted.

dropzone.title: Drag and drop a file here
dropzone.hint: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, JPG or PNG · up to {max} per file

status.done: The file was uploaded and verified successfully.

errors.invalid_name: The file name is not valid. Rename the file and try again.
errors.double_extension: File names with more than one extension are not allowed (for example, “invoice.exe.pdf”).
errors.type_not_allowed: This file type is not allowed. Use PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, JPG or PNG.
errors.too_large: The file exceeds the maximum size of {max}.
errors.quota_exceeded: The file could not be uploaded to your account. Please contact the administrator.
errors.daily_cap: You have reached the daily upload limit. Try again tomorrow.
errors.rate_limited: Too many uploads in a short time. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.recaptcha_failed: We could not verify your request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.content_rejected: The file content does not match its type or contains active content (macros, scripts or executables).
errors.size_mismatch: The uploaded file does not match the selected file. Please try again.
errors.upload_missing: The upload did not complete. Please try again.
errors.intent_invalid: The upload authorization expired. Please try again.
errors.invalid_category: The selected category is not available.
errors.network: The connection was interrupted during the upload. Please try again.
errors.generic: The file could not be uploaded. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalid_owner: The selected user cannot receive files.

Profile.description: Manage your personal details, language, password and security.

details.heading: Personal details
details.name: Full name
details.emailHint: To change your email address, contact the administrator.

language.heading: Preferred language
language.description: Used for the interface and for the emails we send you.
language.label: Language

password.heading: Change password
password.description: After the change, other active sessions are closed.

mfa.heading: Two-step verification
mfa.enabledBody: Two-step verification is enabled. You will be asked for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.
mfa.disabledBody: Add a second layer of protection: when you sign in, you will also need a code from an authenticator app.
mfa.requiredForAdmins: Two-step verification is mandatory for administrator accounts and cannot be disabled.
mfa.disableHint: Enter a current code from your authenticator app to confirm.

activity.heading: Recent sign-in activity
activity.description: If you see activity you do not recognize, change your password and contact the administrator.
activity.empty: There is no recorded activity yet.

users.description: Accounts with access to the platform. Registration is closed: users join only by invitation.

invite.description: The person will receive an email, in the selected language, with a link to set their password. The link expires in 24 hours.
invite.name: Full name
invite.roleNote: Invited accounts always have the user role.

users.empty: There are no users matching the filters.

detail.quotaHint: Between 0 and 102,400 MB. Uploads that exceed the quota are rejected.
detail.uploadForUser: Upload a file for this user
detail.activityEmpty: There is no recorded activity for this account.
detail.self: This is your own account. Manage it from your profile.

actions.deactivateBody: The user will lose access immediately and all active sessions will be closed. Their files are kept.
actions.activateBody: The user will be able to sign in again with their current password.
actions.resendBody: A new invitation email will be sent. The previous link stops working.
actions.forceResetBody: The current password will stop working, all sessions will be closed and the user will receive an email to set a new password.
actions.forceResetDone: The password was reset and the user was notified.

files.description: All files on the platform. Files moved to the trash can be restored for 30 days.
files.trashTitle: Move this file to the trash?
files.trashBody: “{name}” will no longer be visible to the user. It can be restored from the trash for 30 days.
files.trashed: The file was moved to the trash.
files.empty: There are no files matching the filters.
files.uploadDescription: The file is verified before it is stored, and the user receives an email notification in their language.
files.noOwners: There are no active users to receive files.
files.ownerRequired: Select the user who will receive the file.

trash.description: Files moved to the trash. They are deleted permanently and automatically 30 days after being moved here.
trash.restoreBody: “{name}” will be visible to the user again.
trash.deleteBody: “{name}” will be deleted permanently. This action cannot be undone.

categories.description: Categories help classify files. Archived categories stay on existing files but cannot be selected for new uploads.
categories.archiveBody: “{name}” will no longer be available for new uploads. Existing files keep it.

audit.description: Append-only record of security-relevant actions. Entries cannot be modified or deleted.
audit.empty: There are no entries matching the filters.
